remarks: This listing is for 2 Adjacent Parcels: 1 Caroline Pl & 130 Halstead Ave. Move-in ready & located in the Glenville School District, this home offers exceptional value with 5 beds, 3.5 baths, water views, and no work required! Sunny, bright interiors offer generous room sizes and an easy, functional layout. With extensive renovations in 2023, the 2nd fl was fully redesigned to enhance flow and add a spacious primary suite w/ an outfitted walk-in closet and private bath. The combination of space, functionality, and turnkey condition, present an outstanding opportunity to secure size, comfort, and convenience in Greenwich. Included is 130 Halstead Ave, the adjacent buildable lot, offering added flexibility and upside. 1 Caroline Pl is FEMA excluded from flood zone.
